title: ConcreteColumnConfiguration
description: ConcreteColumnConfiguration: Concrete column required to support a given number of stories at a given floor height, including the amount of reinforcement it contains.

ColumnSection.description: Section of the column required for this configuration. ConcreteSection: Concrete section to be used on Bars. Defined by a section profile. Note that all section constants are assuming an uncracked section and are disregarding reinforcement.

Reinforcement.description: Amount of reinforcement in the Column. ReinforcementDensity: The reinforcement density of an element and its material.

FloorHeight.description: Floor-to-floor height that the column configuration is designed for. Property has a quantity of type Length measured in [m].

NumberOfStories.description: Number of stories supported by the column in this configuration.

_bhomVersion.description: Optional version of BHoM used as part of automatic versioning and schema upgrades.
